title: Mia the Cat
text:
Kasia has a cat. Its name is Mia. Mia is white and very soft. Every evening, Kasia gives Mia fresh water and food.

Mia likes to sleep on the sofa. She visits the vet once a year to stay healthy. Kasia loves her cat very much. Mia is part of the family.

questions.text: What is the name of Kasia's cat?
Where does Mia like to sleep?
Why is Kasia a caring owner?
options: She gives Mia food and water

not hard when you touch it
the people you live with and love

paragraph_translations: Kasia ma kota. Jego imię to Mia. Mia jest biała i bardzo miękka. Każdego wieczoru Kasia daje Mii świeżą wodę i jedzenie.
Mia lubi spać na kanapie. Raz w roku odwiedza weterynarza, żeby być zdrowa. Kasia bardzo kocha swojego kota. Mia jest częścią rodziny.
